race.dungeondelving.human.description: Versatile: +1 to every ability score, and a bonus ability point every 4 character levels.
race.dungeondelving.dwarf.description: Stout and short. Darkvision underground (below sea level, out of the sky), and mines all ore 25% faster.
race.dungeondelving.elf.description: Light-footed: takes no damage from falls of up to 5 blocks, and their arrows fly 10% faster.
race.dungeondelving.halfling.description: Small and lucky: a much smaller target, and +1 luck (better loot and fishing).

race.dungeondelving.gnome.description: Small and clever: 5% faster spell casting and cooldowns (Iron's Spells), and 10% more crafting skill XP.

race.dungeondelving.dragonborn.descripti: Draconic: a little larger, and can breathe fire in a cone ahead (racial ability key, H) every 30 seconds.

class.dungeondelving.rogue.description: Quick and deadly. Skill tree: the Rogue path. Passive: +5% attack speed, +3% movement speed.
class.dungeondelving.mage.description: A master of magic. Skill tree: the Arcane, Fire, Frost and Priest paths. Passive: +0.5 spell power, +10% mana regen, +20 max mana. (Every class can cast; mages cast better.)
